title: Poisson and Weyl lifts of an explicit three-dimensional Keller map and nonunique self-adjoint realizations of a dual transport operator
description: Dan-approved A001 package with release identifier v0.3.9-referee-revision and version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21715479. The project-level concept DOI remains 10.5281/zenodo.21474351. The revised paper states Hilbert deficiency indices n_+=n_-=aleph0 for the canonical H=-iX1, using the forward maximal sheet and sign-involution transport in the main proof. The synchronized Lean publication freeze is 2e40c4cab86a1ef97cb3334497d10081dfe33867; it is untagged and unreleased. It is a provenance-only successor to fbcdd034; theorem and audit source are unchanged. The historical theorem-source root is ff50f4a2a312591c2e5b26e71eb390ade9164b34. Lean proves an injective family of distinct self-adjoint-extension witnesses parameterized by unitary complex phases. The continuum lower-family corollary additionally uses the classical cardinality of the complex unit circle; that cardinal identification is not one of the cited Lean declarations. PUBLICATION_PROVENANCE.md records focused TheoremFPlusITransport (8,684 jobs) and TheoremFExtensionMultiplicity (8,692 jobs) builds, the full 8,702-job build, and a nine-declaration axiom audit. Lean/build, math.FA/math.AG, non-claims, and package/metadata gates pass; Dan approved publication on 2026-07-30. No preferred extension, arbitrary-operator theorem, exact Hamel rank, exact cardinality of the full extension type, strong CCR, physical selection, or rank-three Dixmier counterexample is claimed. No arXiv identifier is asserted.
